name: Chosen
overview: Scripture reveals that God has chosen His people to be holy and set apart above all others, as seen in Deuteronomy where Israel is called a special and peculiar people unto the LORD. This divine election is purposeful and sovereign, demonstrated in Jesus' selection of the twelve disciples, even acknowledging that one would betray Him. The concept of being chosen also carries a solemn warning, as many are called but few are chosen, emphasizing the necessity of genuine faith and perseverance. God's choosing is for the salvation of His elect, shown in the Lord's mercy in shortening difficult days so that some might be saved.
